notes.title: flying clouds
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43169084/0acf36aa4224cad5244b9dbbbbd75269b0116b0c.png[/img]
Aim at the cloud that can fly, press Y, you can move forward, backward, left, and right, then press F to fly, the space bar goes up, and the left ALT goes down! If you want to cancel, you must press F to cancel the flight, then press Y after landing
--
This function has not been perfected, but he has a higher speed than the character's own flight. If you want to travel far, you can use it

notes.title: 2023/01/11 update
notes.notes:
1. Some optimizations have been made, now you don't need to wait too long to enter the game
2. Many people hate the night too much, so the night is not so long now, and the small island in the distance can be clearly seen.
3. Brother Skull is too annoying, so we decided to eliminate some of them, greatly reducing the difficulty of travel
